NONE: › the act of speaking to someone severely or angrily because of something they have done or failed to do
嚴厲的批評；厲聲的指責；憤怒的譴責

example: I got a rap on the knuckles for not finishing my essay on time.
我因為沒有按時完成論文受到了嚴厲的批評。
He said that many children in the city's schools were getting/being given a raw deal by being taught in classes that were too large.
他說，城裡許多小學生在教育方面沒有得到公正的待遇，因為班級人數太多了。

NONE: › the act of trying very hard to imagine something

example: It takes (quite) a reach of the imagination to believe that story.
沒有很好的想像力真是難以相信那個說法。

NONE: › a period of time when a ruler controls people in a violent and cruel way

example: We've got a right one here, eh!
「我們這裡有個笨蛋，是不是！」
Jim's rose garden is a riot of colour.
吉姆的玫瑰園五彩繽紛。

NONE: › the condition of being very old; used especially to talk about someone who has a long healthy life

example: I'm sure he'll live to a ripe old age.
我肯定他會高夀的。
The party was a roaring success.

NONE: › said to mean that a person who is always travelling and changing jobs has the advantage of having no responsibilities, but also has disadvantages such as having no permanent place to live
滾石不生苔，來去真自在（表示經常在外遊蕩或老換工作的人可以不用擔負責任，但是也居無定所）

example: Hal was a bit of a rolling stone before he married and settled down.
哈爾以前生活有些漂泊不定，直到婚後才安頓下來。
She gave him enough money to get a roof over his head.
她給他的錢足夠他找個住處了。

建築業今年困難重重。
